repositories.title: Payload Repositories

repositories.heroDesc: A curated list of community projects, grouped by developer. Check a repository for its latest release, download a payload straight into your library, or open the project page to read up first.
repositories.addRepositoryDesc: Prospero will watch it for its latest release — nothing is downloaded automatically.

saves.restoreDesc: This overwrites the current save for {name} with the backup from {date}.
saves.deleteBackupDesc: This backup of {name} from {date} will be permanently removed.
saves.saveDataDesc: Backs up the raw save-image files as-is — a byte-for-byte copy, not a browsable/decrypted view.

saves.downloadZipTitle: Download a ZIP of this save to your browser

settings.dangerZoneDesc: Advanced, disruptive actions — not part of everyday use.
settings.shutdownDesc: Stops the running app. Redeploy the ELF (or run it again from the loader) to bring it back.
settings.shutdownConfirmDesc: This stops the app immediately. You'll need to redeploy or relaunch the ELF to use it again.
settings.visualEffectsDesc: Separate from your browser/OS's own reduced-motion setting — this always applies, on any device.
settings.effectsReducedDesc: Less blur and decorative motion for constrained browsers.
settings.appearanceDesc: Choose a complete interface theme. It changes instantly and is remembered by this browser.
settings.thermalDesc: Live CPU, SoC and M.2 readings, and fan cooling behavior.
settings.aboutDesc: Credits, source link, and special thanks.
settings.thermalUnavailableDesc: This needs a real PS5 — temperature sensors aren't reachable right now.
settings.thermalMonitoring: CPU, SoC and M.2 are being monitored live.
settings.coolingBehaviorDesc: Lower threshold = fan starts earlier (cooler, louder). Higher threshold = fan starts later (quieter, warmer).
settings.higherThresholdWarn: Higher thresholds allow the system to get warmer before active cooling begins.
settings.consoleOverviewDesc: Live status of the PS5 this session is connected to.
settings.storageDesc: Free space on every volume ProsperoMgr can see.
settings.payloadsDirDesc: Where Prospero stores and looks for payload files. Point this at a folder shared with another homebrew manager to avoid keeping duplicate copies.
settings.payloadsDirSaved: Saved — restart ProsperoMgr.elf to use the new directory
settings.autostartBundledDesc: Separate from the sequence below — turning this off only skips bundled payloads (ftpsrv, klogsrv, ...) in your sequence. Your own imported payloads still run.
settings.autostartOffToast: Bundled payloads will no longer autostart
settings.autoloaderDesc: Launches selected payloads automatically after Prospero starts.
settings.autoloaderRowDesc: Run the sequence below automatically on boot.
settings.startupDelayDesc: Wait this long after Prospero starts before beginning the sequence.
settings.retriesDesc: How many times to retry a payload that fails to launch.
settings.timeBetweenDesc: Pause after each step so the previous payload has time to finish starting.
settings.continueOnFailureDesc: Keep going with the next payload if one fails to launch.
settings.issueMultipleKstuff: More than one kstuff payload is queued. Keep only the version for this firmware.
settings.issueEtaHenKstuff: etaHEN already includes its required runtime; remove the standalone kstuff entry.
settings.issueNoPayload: Add at least one payload before running the sequence.
settings.sequenceDesc: Runs top to bottom, in order.
settings.noStepsDesc: Add a payload from "Add to sequence" below to build the startup sequence.
settings.addWaitDesc: Adds a pause between sequence steps — different from the startup delay above, which only happens once before the sequence begins.
settings.resolveIssuesFirst: Resolve the issues above before running.
settings.offlineActivationDesc: Activate a local PS5 account for offline use. Prospero backs up the account first, so you can always restore it.
settings.activateCardDesc: Marks a local account as activated. Enough for some games and apps to treat it as an activated profile.
settings.signInCardDesc: Goes further and makes the account appear signed in to the system. Only available for the current user, and needs a reboot to fully apply.
settings.noAccountsDesc: This needs a real PS5 with at least one local user configured.
settings.accountIdDesc: A unique hexadecimal identifier used for offline activation.
settings.backupNoticeBeforeChange: Prospero will back up the current account state before applying this change.
settings.signedInToast: Signed in as {name} — restart your PS5 to finish applying the change
settings.signInFailedToast: Could not sign in with this account: {message}
settings.slotRestoredToast: Slot {slot} restored — restart your PS5 to finish applying it
settings.restoreAccountDesc: This restores {name} (slot {slot}) to the state saved before the previous Prospero activation/sign-in change.
settings.experimentalDesc: Features here are still being refined and may behave differently across firmware or jailbreak environments.
settings.aboutTagline: Prospero Manager — Web-Based All-In-One homebrew manager for your PS5!
settings.communityCredit: Everyone testing, reporting issues, sharing logs, and helping improve the project.
settings.runAgainDesc: These payloads appear to be loaded already. Prospero will run the complete sequence again.
settings.smpDesc: Folders ShadowMountPlus scans for game dumps to auto-mount. Doesn't require ShadowMountPlus to be running now.
settings.smpDefaultsDesc: Add a path below to scan only your own locations instead.
settings.smpResetToast: Reset to the default scan locations
settings.smpDuplicatePath: This path is already in the list
settings.accountIdHelpTitle: Where do I find an Account ID?
settings.accountIdHelpIntro: For plain offline use you don't need a real one — Prospero suggests a valid ID for you. Use a real account ID only when this profile should match an existing PSN account.
settings.accountIdHelpThisConsole: An account already on this console: open Technical details on its card above and copy Account ID.
settings.accountIdHelpOtherConsole: An account from another PS5: run Prospero Manager on that console and copy it the same way.
settings.accountIdHelpSaveData: That account's save data also carries its ID, so a save copied over from the other console works as a source.
settings.accountIdHelpLookup: If the account has never been on a console, PSNTools.com's PSN Account Checker can resolve it from the online ID — it shows a decimal Account ID, so convert that to hexadecimal before pasting it above:
settings.accountIdHelpFormat: The format is 16 hexadecimal digits, with or without the leading 0x — for example 0x7624e1486074cc13.

onboarding.step1Desc: It manages everything on your jailbroken PS5 from a browser — files, homebrew, packages, and save backups — no companion app needed.
onboarding.step1Tip: Your installed games show up on Home, with whatever is currently running highlighted first.
onboarding.step2Desc: Browse and edit files directly on the console, and install .pkg packages from your computer, a URL, or a path already on the PS5.
onboarding.step2Tip: Drag and drop a file or a .pkg anywhere on those screens to upload it.
onboarding.step3Desc: Homebrew tools (payloads) live here — launch them, organize them, and choose which ones start automatically on boot.
onboarding.step3Tip: Browse community payloads in Payload Repositories, or drop your own .elf in.
onboarding.stepPkgDesc: Install a .pkg from your computer, a URL, or a path already on the PS5 — games and homebrew both install the same way.
onboarding.stepPkgTip: Payload Repositories (in the sidebar) lists community homebrew you can grab in one click.
onboarding.step4Desc: That covers the everyday parts. Advanced tools — running processes, logs, thermals, account tools — are all in Settings when you need them.
